purpose: Canonical fail-closed classification of repository-relative source, authority, evidence, generated, runtime, secret, packaging, prepared, and unresolved surfaces.

control_rationale.risk_prevented: Accidental deletion, relocation, reclassification, or misuse of active catalogs, immutable evidence, authorization records, source data, local runtime state, secrets, packaging inputs, or historical paths whose exact names and bytes remain lineage-bound.
control_rationale.decision_improved: A human, Codex, tests, and CI can determine a path role without guessing from filenames, version suffixes, timestamps, or Git ignore status.
control_rationale.why_simpler_rules_are_insufficient: Authoritative local evidence and state can be ignored, historical modules can remain exact-path lineage, active pointers are separate machine-readable controls, and similarly named current, retired, generated, and packaging surfaces coexist.

principles: Directory presence does not grant research authority.
A version suffix does not determine currentness.
Exact cleanup requires a fresh machine-local census and separate approval.
Exact historical paths remain in place until reference and hash closure are proven.
